audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Jax, Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Jax, Kennen, Kennen. Rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 contradict both the packet chart and the page's own prose: whys[0] says Kennen pokes and you just farm; whys[2] says your full combo is online and he is squishy with no dash; whys[3] says the margin stays even; whys[5] says it stays a skill check.
audit.why: Level 3 is the page's stated flip point and the chart had Kennen winning it. Level 1 had Jax winning a lane the prose says you lose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 = Kennen, 2 = Jax, 3 = Skill, 5 = Skill, with ratings moved to match, proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Rows 1, 4 and 6 already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers — 'his escape, stun when it's down'.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s, so early it is a real 10s window and late it is nearly always up; Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank, which is the single most punishable cooldown in the lane and the concrete reason to bait it.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written in, plus Counter Strike 17s and Leap Strike 8s.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] 'Key Ability Interactions' said only 'stun when Lightning Rush is down'. The stun that actually decides the lane — Mark of the Storm — was never named there, and the page implied Counter Strike is a general answer.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming ATTACKS. Kennen's Thundering Shuriken, Electrical Surge and Lightning Rush all apply a Mark through it, and three Marks stun you regardless. Lightning Rush also passes through units, so minion-blocking does not stop his approach.
audit.corrected: report[5] rewritten around the three-Mark stun and what Counter Strike does and does not stop; dontsFull[1].d given the real reason with the Mercury's Treads tenacity answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR' but its description was the generic good-trade line.
audit.why: Kennen's entire kit is magic damage, which is why MR is the do — the description never said so.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the actual MR reasoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] ('Dodge his Q poke') and dontsFull[2] ('Fight his R zone') both carried copy-pasted descriptions about Lightning Rush and burning E.
audit.why: Descriptions did not describe their headings.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now gives Thundering Shuriken's 950 range and the minion-block answer; dontsFull[2].d now describes the Slicing Maelstrom zone.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Stun when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lightning Rush: 10s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — his escape, and it applies a Mark. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s flat, so a baited ult buys two free minutes. - Counter Strike: 17s. - Leap Strike: 8s.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. Stun when it’s down. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — Counter Strike stops his autos, never Q, W or Lightning Rush.

edits.before: Hold E until Kennen commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: His whole kit is magic damage — Mercury's Treads plus Spectre's Cowl blunt the poke and the ult.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is a skillshot at 950 range — hold behind a minion.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Mark of the Storm procs stun you; Mercury's Treads cut it.

edits.before: Burning E on nothing — your counter-stun is the matchup; without it you are a man with a lamppost.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom chain-stuns anyone inside its zone — leave it, then re-engage on his exit.
